description.en: A quick and easy recipe for a delicious brownie pie, often referred to as an 'Impossible Pie' due to its simple preparation and self-layering during baking.
description.he: מתכון מהיר וקל לפאי בראוניז טעים, המכונה לעיתים 'פאי בלתי אפשרי' בשל הכנתו הפשוטה והיווצרות שכבות מעצמה במהלך האפייה.

ingredients.he: 1 חפיסת שוקולד מתוק (113 גרם), מומס ומקורר

en: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Pour the mixture into a pie dish.
he: אפה ב-175°C (350 מעלות פרנהייט) למשך 35 דקות.

ocrRawText:
Impos. Brownie pie
4 egg
1/4 c marg melted
1 bar (4oz) sweet chocolate
melted & cooled
1/4 c brown sugar
1/2 c Bisq.
1/2 c gran. sugar
3/4 c. Chop. nuts
350° - 35 min

It correctly identifies '1/4 cup Bisquick' (the self-rising flour product that makes 'Impossible Pie' work), while Result B misreads it as '1/4 cup flour' and incorrectly lists '4 tbsp margarine' instead of '1/4 cup'. Result A's baking time of 35 minutes matches the OCR, while Result B claims 31 minutes without OCR support. Result A's ingredient quantities are consistent (no duplicate sugar entries), and the description accurately explains the 'Impossible Pie' concept. Result B has contradictory sugar measurements and less plausible ingredients for this cake-like pie.
